learned: 2026-10-05, agent pass: /products holds 9 flavour cards (Framer); no size or dose anywhere on the site.
notes: A Framer site. layup.nyc redirects here; the root is an age gate linking to ./fullhome, and /products answers directly. Each flavour card is the div whose child layer is named '1:1 Product Image'; the card's own layer name (data-framer-name) is the flavour. Framer's class names are generated, so the recipe keys on layer names, not classes.

The site gives no size or dose. Every LayUp is one 10mg can, which is how NY stores list every flavour ('LayUp | Peach Tea | 10mg'), so the size is a constant. A new format (a multipack, another dose) would need its own rule.
Category is implicit: all are THC beverages.
On 2026-10-05 stores also sold Futbol Punch, Playoff Punch and Rocket Pop (all 10mg), which no page of the site mentions: limited flavours, kept from the stores' consensus.
